params.name: status
params.description: Comma-separated subset of pending,verified,confirmed,rejected,verification_expired. Defaults to 'verified' (the rows admins can act on).

params.name: search
params.description: Case-insensitive substring search across first_name, last_name, email, organization.

items.docs:
List registration requests for the admin Pending Users tab.

Sorted by created_at DESC so newest submissions surface first.

Mark a verified registration request as admin-confirmed.

Body (optional)::

    {"notes": "Saw them at QIP poster session"}

The endpoint records the admin event (confirmed_at, confirmed_by,
optional notes) and flips status verified -> confirmed. The
subscription_manager worker then creates the matching user row and
drafts a welcome email; the API does not block on either.

Idempotency: any non-verified state returns 409. Race-safe via the
pre-update WHERE clause.
